levels.name: Returning Heiress of the Scarlet Sands
levels.description: The duration of Prayer of the Crimson Crown effect triggered by Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide is increased by 3s.

levels.name: Moon-Piercing Brilliance
levels.description: When Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum hits opponents, Candace's Max HP will be increased by 20% for 15s.

levels.name: Hunter's Supplication
levels.description: Increases the Level of Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Sentinel Oath
levels.description: Shortens the Hold CD of Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum to be the same as that of the Tapping CD.

levels.name: Heterochromatic Gaze
levels.description: Increases the Level of Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: The Overflow
levels.description: When characters (excluding Candace herself) affected by the Prayer of the Crimson Crown caused by Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide deal Elemental DMG to opponents using Normal Attacks, an attack wave will be unleashed that deals AoE Hydro DMG equal to 15% of Candace's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 2.3s and is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
